# Draft:GDome UN ECA SDG Award Winner 2023

----
GDome is a South African manufacturer of waterproof dome housings for action cameras, smartphones, and DSLR/mirrorless cameras. The company is operated by Action Distribution PTY LTD, based in South Africa, and sells products globally through its website and retailers including Amazon and B&H Photo.
Products
GDome manufactures several lines of waterproof dome port housings:
* GDome Mobile – Waterproof dome housings for smartphones including iPhone and Android devices. Available in versions 1, 2, and 3, with the later versions featuring improved capacitive touch response and a side-seal system.
* GDome GoPro Series – Dome port housings for GoPro action cameras, enabling split-shot (half above, half below water) photography and video.
* GDome XL – A universal waterproof housing for DSLR and mirrorless cameras compatible with bodies from Sony, Canon, Nikon, Fujifilm, and other manufacturers.
All GDome housings are rated to 5 metres (15 feet) depth and are designed for surf, snorkelling, and shallow underwater photography.
Dome port technology
A dome port is a curved optical element that corrects the refractive index difference between water and air, allowing wide-angle lenses to produce sharp underwater images. GDome housings use this technology to enable over-under or split-shot photography, where half the image is above and half below the water surface.
Recognition
GDome founder Brett Eagle was named one of six winners of the United Nations Economic Commission for Africa (UNECA) Youth SDGs Innovation Award, which recognises African youth innovators whose work advances the Sustainable Development Goals. The award citation described GDome Ltd as having "developed the world's first range of universal, semi-rigid, underwater housings".
Distribution
GDome products are available through the company's website at getgdome.com, as well as through Amazon and B&H Photo. The company ships globally from South Africa.
Media coverage
GDome products have been featured in photography and outdoor publications including:
* The Inertia, which listed GDome in its guide to water housings for surf photography.
* The Adventure Junkies, which included GDome in its "Best Underwater Camera Housings of 2025" roundup.
* Backcountry Cow, which published a full review of the GDome GoPro Split Shot Dome.
